mapper.select: SELECT uid FROM weibo_account_gate WHERE uid = #{uid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weibo_post WHERE target_uid = #{uid} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weibo_publish_attempt WHERE target_uid = #{uid} AND started_at >= #{since}
SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM weibo_publish_attempt WHERE target_uid = #{uid}
SELECT * FROM weibo_post WHERE target_uid = #{uid} AND event_key = #{eventKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weibo_post (post_key, target_uid, event_key, event_json, body, review_note, content_version, revision, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{targetUid}, #{eventKey}, #{eventJson}, #{body}, #{reviewNote}, #{contentVersion}, #{revision}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM weibo_post ORDER BY created_at DESC, post_key LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weibo_post_history (post_key, revision, content_version, status, body, reviewer, review_reason, attempt_id, weibo_id, last_error, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{revision}, #{contentVersion}, #{status}, #{body}, #{reviewer}, #{reviewReason}, #{attemptId}, #{weiboId}, #{lastError}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM weibo_post_history WHERE post_key = #{id} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weibo_publish_attempt (attempt_id, post_id, target_uid, content_version, status, started_at) VALUES (#{attemptId}, #{id}, #{targetUid}, #{contentVersion}, #{status}, #{publishStartedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE weibo_publish_attempt SET status = #{status}, weibo_id = #{weiboId}, last_error = #{lastError}, completed_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'PUBLISHING'
